mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON rm.role_id = u.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id
SELECT DISTINCT rm.menu_id FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.deleted = 0
